scope: Ten focused references. Bibliographic verification and supported claims, not reproduction of cited results. Candidate manuscript citation-to-sentence audit pending.

references.title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
references.support_scope: Variational inference, reparameterization and autoencoder methodology.
references.does_not_support: AMP activity, novelty of our architecture, or reconstruction implying generation quality.
references.verification: Author-deposited arXiv page; originally submitted 2013; do not label this DOI a 2014 journal publication.

references.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
references.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33
references.does_not_support: AMP biological efficacy or matched superiority of our model.
references.verification: Author-deposited arXiv title/authors/year verified; DOI is arXiv DOI, not proceedings DOI.

references.title: Recurrent Neural Network Model for Constructive Peptide Design
references.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
references.support_scope: Sequence-based LSTM peptide generation is established prior art.
references.does_not_support: Our terminal-conditioned LSTM is an exact reproduction of this paper or its published performance.
references.verification: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; title, authors, DOI, publication data verified.

references.title: Deep learning regression model for antimicrobial peptide design
references.support_scope: CNN-based quantitative MIC prediction and GRAMPA are prior work.
references.does_not_support: Peer-reviewed Bioinformatics publication; our QMAP-adapted PyTorch port reproduces original performance.
references.verification: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; title, authors, DOI, publication data verified.

references.title: DBAASP v3: database of antimicrobial/cytotoxic activity and structure of peptides as a resource for development of new therapeutics
references.support_scope: DBAASP documents peptide structures, chemical modifications and activity records.
references.does_not_support: Our fixed200 subset is representative, complete, identically assayed, or independent at the row level.
references.verification: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; title, authors, DOI, publication data verified. Online 2020-11-05; print issue 2021, 49(D1):D288-D297.

references.title: Discovering highly potent antimicrobial peptides with deep generative model HydrAMP
references.support_scope: Conditional VAE generation, candidate preselection, and peptide-specific experimental validation are distinct stages.
references.does_not_support: Its wet-lab validation transfers to our historical27 peptides or new H5 models.
references.verification: Publisher-deposited Crossref metadata; title, authors, DOI, publication data verified.

correction.scope: 2023 author correction fixes Figure2 inadvertently duplicated from Figure5; do not use uncorrected figure.

references.title: AMPGen: an evolutionary information-reserved and diffusion-driven generative model for de novo design of antimicrobial peptides
references.support_scope: Established diffusion-based AMP design with explicit screening and linked synthesis/assays.
references.does_not_support: Classifier-independent pipeline, fair numerical success-rate comparison to our27, or novelty of diffusion for AMP.

references.title: PRO-LDM: A Conditional Latent Diffusion Model for Protein Sequence Design and Functional Optimization
references.support_scope: Latent diffusion for protein sequence design is established; published GFP functional assays are separate from sequence statistics.
references.does_not_support: AMP-specific matched baseline or evidence about our generated sequences.
references.verification: Official full article, first online2025-06-30, volume12 issue34 e02723.
references.recommended_use: Optional; omit if no concrete sentence needs it.

references.title: QMAP: a benchmark for standardized evaluation of antimicrobial peptide MIC and hemolytic activity regression
references.support_scope: Prior quantitative AMP benchmark; five predefined homology-aware test splits, common supported tasks, released software; direct provenance for cached adapted CNN.
references.does_not_support: Our native-unit small-subset results reproduce QMAP: its species merging and micromolar conversion differ from ours.

references.title: Generative models for antimicrobial peptide design: auto-encoders and beyond
references.support_scope: Direct prior comparative study of VAE/WAE/RNN/LM sampling and metric sensitivity; reconstruction treated as a proxy, not generation quality.
references.does_not_support: Our bounded developmental case study is the first comparative AMP evaluation or validates a broad benchmark.
